purpose: Restore the paper state-labeling and linear-probing pipeline; evaluate early warnings against actual final outcomes.
label_rule: paper equations, retain p >= alpha; no temporal maximum
primary_warning_rule: First failure prediction by the fixed primary layer before a real action; do not stop or steer the actor.
training_target: Conformal-derived intermediate-state label, never real final outcome as a fallback.

development_only.horizon_reason: All successful selected-task development trajectories finished in two actions.
development_only.mc_budget_reason: Four complete continuations per prefix keep this local pilot bounded; an earlier MC8/H4 development timing run was stopped for cost.

stop_gates: No timestep permits both conformal target classes: stop after calibration.
No probe has at least two training examples per class: stop before final test.
limitations: Small-model/MiniWoB adaptation, not reproduction of original SFT agent or benchmarks.
Two-action horizon; does not establish long-horizon warning performance.
Finite-sample rank labels are per timestep; no simultaneous episode or probe error guarantee.
Linear separability is association, not causal failure direction.
Do not tune on evaluation outcomes or substitute final outcomes for ambiguous labels.
